title: Fix the "Totall" typo
environment: Claude Code headless (claude -p) on a berth box, auto permission mode
repo: acme-invoices (examples/acme-invoices in this repo), copied to a fresh git repo
prompt: /shipit the CLI summary prints "Totall" instead of "Total". fix the typo.

steps.name: Bash
steps.output:
README.md
examples/order.json
package.json
src/cli.js
src/invoice.js
test/invoice.test.js
src/cli.js:11:console.log(`Totall:   ${formatCents(t.total)}`);
{
  "name": "acme-invoices",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": { "test": "node --test", "invoice": "node src/cli.js" }
}

steps.name: Bash
steps.summary: cat src/cli.js && sed -i 's/Totall:   /Total:    /' src/cli.js && git diff && node src/cli.js examples/order.json && npm test 2>&1 | tail -8

result:
The CLI summary now prints "Total" instead of "Totall". The fix is at `src/cli.js:11`, and I added one space after the label so the amount still lines up with the other rows.

**Check.** I ran `node src/cli.js examples/order.json` and the last line is now `Total:    $55.06`, aligned with Subtotal, Discount and Tax. `npm test` passes 3 of 3.

Nothing is committed yet. Say the word if you want a commit or PR.
notes: The demo app's README names the planted bug. That paragraph was removed from the copy before the run, so the agent had to find the cause itself.
